subject: TigerTrail pilot — temporary PO carveout and onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Erin Wu <erin.wu@tigertrail.io>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: finance@tigertrail.io
Date: Fri, 14 Feb 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot onboarding — request for temporary no-PO path

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at TigerTrail is excited to kick off the 6-week pilot next week. We usually require purchase orders for onboarding, but our procurement is tight around the pilot timeline. Would Redwood consider a temporary "invoice-only" onboarding for the pilot (no PO required), with an agreed upper limit and evidence package?

Quick background: we are a Series B company (TigerTrail.io). This engagement covers pre-production data sync and inference calls (~50K tokens/day expected).

Requested items we can provide immediately: W-9, SOW draft, security summary, and a finance contact for invoices.

Can you confirm what minimal evidence Redwood needs and how we can proceed without delaying the pilot start?

Thanks —
Erin
Director, Partnerships
TigerTrail, Inc.
[Attachment: TigerTrail_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: TigerTrail_W9.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: erin.wu@tigertrail.io
Date: Fri, 14 Feb 2025 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for temporary no-PO path

Naomi / Priyom — looped in to check procurement and sales options. They want to start next week and can provide W-9, SOW draft, and a security summary.

Questions for procurement: can we do a time-limited invoice-only onboarding for a pilot customer? If so, what's the evidence pack and dollar cap we should enforce?

Priyom — if procurement prefers not to make an exception, any quick alternatives (prepay, card, credit hold) that would keep the pipeline moving?

I'll hold off replying to Erin until we confirm the path.

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: TigerTrail_Security_Summary.pdf]

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: erin.wu@tigertrail.io
Date: Fri, 14 Feb 2025 11:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for temporary no-PO path

Jonas — thanks for the heads-up. We can support a controlled invoice-only onboarding for pilots, but require a minimal evidence set and controls. Proposed guardrails: 

- Evidence pack (required before onboarding): W-9, signed SOW or pilot acceptance form, basic security summary (high level), AP contact + billing email.
- Financial controls: Invoice-only status limited to the pilot period and a not-to-exceed cap of $25,000. Anything above must follow standard PO process.
- Accounting steps: Vendor record created as "Pilot - Invoice Only" with expiration date; invoices routed to vendorpilot@redwood.com for expedited review.
- Risk checks: quick sanctions/PEP screening + domain verification.

If TigerTrail provides the W-9, SOW, and security summary by EOD Monday (2/17), procurement can provision the temporary vendor record and notify accounting. I will need the finance contact and the exact invoice remit email.

I am attaching the internal checklist and the pilot vendor agreement template for signatures.

Naomi Feldman
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: procurement_pilot_checklist.pdf (internal)]

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: erin.wu@tigertrail.io, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Feb 2025 09:06:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for temporary no-PO path

Erin — cc'd Naomi who will own the pilot carveout. Two quick commercial alternatives if you prefer not to be on an invoice-only track:

1) Short prepayment: TigerTrail pre-pays first two weeks via card or wire; we offset against the pilot invoices. This avoids vendor provisioning delays.
2) Credit hold: Redwood can open a short credit line (requires finance form) for pilot customers with predictable usage.

If TigerTrail can provide the W-9 and signed pilot SOW today, Naomi's team can fast-track the invoice-only vendor record and we can start the pilot.

Apologies for the quick turnaround ask — we really want to keep you on the calendar for next Tuesday.

Best,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: erin.wu@tigertrail.io, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Feb 2025 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for temporary no-PO path

Team / Erin — quick update and approval: procurement has authority to create a pilot invoice-only vendor record for TigerTrail with the controls Naomi outlined. Approvals granted with these specifics: 

- Allowed path: Invoice-only (temporary) for the duration of the 6-week pilot.
- Financial cap: $25,000 not-to-exceed.
- Required docs (must be received before vendor activation): signed SOW, W-9, security summary, and AP contact.
- Accounting: invoices to be sent to vendorpilot@redwood.com and marked "TigerTrail Pilot" — accounts will route payment on standard net-30 terms.
- Expiration: vendor record auto-expires 30 days after pilot end unless procurement approves extension.

Jonas — please confirm receipt of the attachments and the signed SOW in thread. Naomi — please proceed with vendor creation after attachments arrive; let me know if any red flags come up.

Erin — welcome aboard; we'll have the intake completed as soon as we get the docs so you can hit next Tuesday.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
